capabilities.name: date_states
capabilities.summary: Per-date states from committed acquisition windows
capabilities.reason: Each date inherits the state of its acquisition window at the pinned Fink revision.
qualifications: Per-date delivered counts (G4A daily coverage) are data-plane artifacts and are not in this basis.

capabilities.name: date_counts
capabilities.reason: Synthetic fixture counts inside the admitted Month-1 window; no counts exist for Month-2 or Month-3 by design.

capabilities.name: transport_totals
capabilities.reason: Three-way reconciled transport totals per validated delivery.
qualifications: Transport totals are not Rubin completeness and must never be compared across windows as rates.

capabilities.name: acquisition.month-1
capabilities.reason: Delivery reconciled three ways (expected topic messages = terminal committed = local readable rows, lag 0) and characterized (G4A). Transport reconciliation is not Rubin scientific completeness. Per-date delivered counts are not committed evidence and are not shown.

capabilities.name: acquisition.month-2
capabilities.reason: Transport-validated but scientifically uncharacterized and not admitted to the analytical cohort. Its delivered row total must not be read as an alert rate or compared with other windows.

capabilities.name: acquisition.month-3
capabilities.reason: Upstream state PRODUCER_COMPLETE: not delivery-validated and not admitted to this basis. This is not missing data; it is not yet available.

capabilities.name: difference_map

capabilities.name: shared_axes
capabilities.reason: Only dimensions with an identical definition_id (kernel-derived Galactic/ecliptic latitude) may share axes across domains.

capabilities.name: shared_utc_date_axis
capabilities.reason: Lanes share UTC-date bins only. Each domain maps its own time scale to UTC dates; MJDs are never aligned across domains.
qualifications: ANTARES MJD is treated as UTC by the historical exporter; Fink midpointMjdTai is TAI.
